hero_description: Hawk Stars is built by people who believe in community, culture, and positive change. Whether you want to become a member or volunteer your time, there's a place for you.
email_subject: I'd like to join Hawk Stars
why_title: More than an NGO — a family.
why_lead: For over a decade, Hawk Stars has brought people together across cultures, borders, and generations. Here's what you become part of.
why_impact_desc: From humanitarian aid to cultural events in Pinhel and across the region, your contribution translates directly into visible, lasting change.
why_community_desc: Join a network of people from different countries and backgrounds, united by shared values and a drive to make things better.
why_growth_desc: Develop skills in project management, communication, and leadership through hands-on experience with real projects and international programmes.
why_europe_desc: Get access to Erasmus+, European Solidarity Corps, and other EU-funded programmes that can take you across the continent.
member_desc: Members are the backbone of Hawk Stars. You'll have voting rights, participate in the General Assembly, and shape the direction of the organization.
member_perk1: Vote and be elected in the General Assembly
member_perk2: Help decide the organization's strategy and projects
member_perk4: Represent Hawk Stars at national and international level
volunteer_desc: Volunteers bring energy, ideas, and hands-on support to our projects. No long-term commitment required — contribute when and how you can.
volunteer_perk1: Join local and international project activities
volunteer_perk2: Participate in Erasmus+ youth exchanges and training
volunteer_perk3: Gain a Youthpass certificate for your experience
volunteer_perk4: Flexible involvement — contribute on your own terms
step1_desc: Send us an email expressing your interest. Tell us a bit about yourself and whether you'd like to become a member or volunteer.
step2_desc: We'll schedule a conversation — online or in person — to get to know each other and find the best fit for your skills and interests.
step3_desc: Once everything is set, you'll be welcomed into the Hawk Stars community and invited to your first activities and projects.
cta_description: Drop us a line and we'll get back to you within a few days. No forms, no bureaucracy — just people.
